mapper.select: SELECT r.CONTEST_ROUND, r.ROUND_NO, r.ENT_USER_ID AS USER_ID, u.NK_NM AS NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_URL AS PROFILE_IMG, t.THEME_NM AS CONTEST_TITLE, r.PET_NM AS PET_NAME, k.KIND_NM AS PET_TYPE, r.TITLE, r.CONTS AS CONTENT, r.PHT_PATH AS FILE_PATH, r.PHT_FILE1 AS LIST_FILE_NAME, r.PHT_FILE2 AS POPUP_FILE_NAME, r.SCORE, r.VW_CNT AS VIEW_COUNT, r.LIKE_CNT AS LIKE_COUNT, r.CMT_CNT AS COMMENT_COUNT, r.ENT_DT AS CREATED_AT FROM pst_contest_round r JOIN pst_user u ON r.ENT_USER_ID = u.USER_ID JOIN pst_contest c ON r.CONTEST_ROUND = c.CONTEST_ROUND JOIN pst_theme t ON c.THEME_CD = t.THEME_CD JOIN pst_pet_kind k ON r.KIND_CD = k.KIND_CD WHERE r.CONTEST_ROUND = #{contestId} ORDER BY r.SCORE DESC, r.ENT_DT DESC

SELECT ca.CONTEST_ROUND, ca.ROUND_NO, t.THEME_NM AS CONTEST_TITLE, ca.AWARD_PART, ca.AWARD_CD, a.AWARD_NM AS PRIZE_NAME, a.BADGE_IMG_PATH_FILE, ca.SCORE, ca.RANKING, r.PET_NM AS PET_NAME, k.KIND_NM AS PET_TYPE, r.TITLE AS POST_TITLE, r.PHT_PATH AS FILE_PATH, r.PHT_FILE1 AS LIST_FILE_NAME, u.USER_ID, u.NK_NM AS NICKNAME, u.PROFILE_URL AS PROFILE_IMG FROM pst_contest_award ca JOIN pst_contest c ON ca.CONTEST_ROUND = c.CONTEST_ROUND JOIN pst_theme t ON c.THEME_CD = t.THEME_CD JOIN pst_award a ON ca.AWARD_CD = a.AWARD_CD JOIN pst_contest_round r ON ca.CONTEST_ROUND = r.CONTEST_ROUND AND ca.ROUND_NO = r.ROUND_NO JOIN pst_user u ON ca.ENT_USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN pst_pet_kind k ON r.KIND_CD = k.KIND_CD WHERE ca.CONTEST_ROUND = #{contestId} ORDER BY ca.AWARD_PART ASC, ca.RANKING ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE pst_contest_round SET SCORE = SCORE + #{scoreDelta}, VW_CNT = VW_CNT + #{viewDelta}, LIKE_CNT = LIKE_CNT + #{likeDelta}, CMT_CNT = CMT_CNT + #{commentDelta} WHERE CONTEST_ROUND = #{contestId} AND ROUND_NO = #{roundNo};
